reasons.text: This AI estimate, not GTO or solver output, squeezes AA 100% to 13BB for value against UTG and HJ rather than taking the closing call.

reasons.text: Call 100%: AJ's suitedness and broadway potential justify the closing price, while UTG's AK/AQ make building a squeeze pot less attractive.
reasons.text_ja: 100%コール。AJのスーテッド性とブロードウェイの可能性はアクションを閉じる価格を支えますが、UTGのAK・AQがあるためスクイーズでポットを大きくする魅力は下がります。

reasons.text: Call 100%: suited AT offers nut-flush and broadway draws at the closing price, but stronger aces in UTG's range discourage squeezing.
